newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks close down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks close down on profit-taking.

text.p: Argentine shares closed down Tuesday, depressed by profit-taking and a dip on Wall Street, traders said.
"The market was hit slightly by profit-taking and also some shadowing of U.S. stocks," one trader said.
The blue-chip MerVal index .MERV slipped 1.52 percent to close at 800.96.
"The market's base continues to be firm. We expect a bit of a fall due to profit taking over the next few days," the trader said. But he added that the Merval was showing resistance at 800 points.
Volume was $27 million, down from $36 million Friday, when the Merval finished 0.1 percent down Friday.
The market was closed for the Flag Day holiday Monday.
